ask: can u make a bracket for these 8 movies till theres one left
sentence: A single-elimination bracket for eight movies where the group votes in each head-to-head match and winners advance through three rounds until one movie is left.
use_when: a group needs to pick one movie out of eight
people want to vote match by match in a knockout bracket
choosing a movie for a group movie night
settling a tie between many options with head-to-head rounds
dont_use_when: there are fewer or more than eight options
a single one-time poll across all options is enough
a round-robin or points ranking is wanted instead of knockout
a tournament with scores or played games, not votes
